name: ZeroLeak Voice v2 paired Vietnamese development and generator holdout
limitations: VIVOS speakers are disjoint by ID; FLEURS speaker IDs and human gender are unknown. No claim of gender balance.
Public read speech and preset TTS, not real-world calls or speaker impersonation.
Piper VAIS and VIVOS share generator architecture; VieNeu Nano is held out as a family.
Matching source transcript prefix does not imply word-time-aligned five-second crops.
Clean/Opus copies share origins and are not independent trials.
Research-only local evaluation; raw audio is not redistributed.
